description: A close English retelling of the Scandinavian folktale in which Ash-Lad succeeds where his brothers fail by refusing the hag’s comfort, learning the colts’ enchanted secret, and using sacred bread and wine to answer the king’s test—then breaking the spell at his wedding.
tone: Classic folktale, brisk, magical, and darkly comic
summary: Ash-Lad outwits a king’s cruel test, learns the truth of seven enchanted colts, and wins a princess by breaking their spell.
